author: Zerg_Space_Cadet
body:
my username is Zerg_Space_Cadet.



I have been banned for ban evasion "zergspacecadet"\



I would like to be unbanned because this is my favorite server like EVER and then one day I joined avicus and it said I was banned from it for ban evading. But I never once ban evaded. I have been banned for like 5 months or so and every time I play minecraft I see if I have been unbanned. Even my mom has tried to get me unbanned, plus whenever I tell others about how I have been banned they always say "wow, you didn't even do anything and you got banned forever for no reason, maybe its a hacker.", I think my brother (zergspacecadet) got on my computer and tried to get his account unbanned, so I did litterly did nothing, hes the one that introduced the server to me. He got banned for advertising.



please unban me, I love this server soooooo much
